frontend.prompt:
Scope: Frontend-only implementation tasks to stop reading or sending the removed title field and to remove fallback logic that used title. Do not change backend or database; explicitly preserve shared API facts listed below.

Preserved API facts (must be honored by frontend code and tests):
- Public responses for entries will no longer include a title property; only name will be present for that piece of data.
- If a request payload includes title, the server will respond 422 (validation error). Frontend must not send title in requests.
- The database field name for title is NOT changed (backend-only); frontend must not attempt to rename DB fields.
- Other entry fields remain unchanged and must continue to be consumed as before: description, id, owner_id, created_at.

Implementation tasks (explicit, actionable):
1) Inventory
  a) Search the codebase for all references to ".title", "entry.title", "item.title", and any string literal or constant named "title" that is used as an API response/read or sent in request payloads.
  b) List all components, utilities, API clients, types/interfaces, serializers, normalizers, state slices, caches, persisted stores, and tests that reference title.

2) API types and client code
  a) Update TypeScript/flow/JS types for server responses: remove title from the response interface for entry objects. Ensure the response type includes name and the unchanged fields (description, id, owner_id, created_at) as previously defined.
  b) Update any API client request builders/serializers to never include title in outgoing payloads. Implement explicit allow-listing of fields for create/update calls (e.g., only include name, description, owner_id, etc. — do not include title). Do not attempt to send or rename DB fields.
  c) Add a unit test for the API client that asserts outgoing request bodies do not contain a title key for create/update calls (spy/mock network call and inspect payload).

3) UI components and rendering
  a) Remove fallback logic that reads title when name is missing. Wherever code previously did something like display (entry.name || entry.title), remove the OR fallback and use entry.name exclusively.
  b) Decide and implement explicit behavior for missing name (do not implement a new fallback to title). Either keep existing missing-name UX or display a neutral placeholder (e.g., "(no name)"), but do not use title. Document the chosen UX in a short comment nearby.
  c) Remove any UI elements or forms that allowed editing or viewing a title field. If a UX change was intended previously to allow editing title, remove that input and associated handlers so title is not included in form state.

4) State management, caching, normalization
  a) Remove title from normalization schemas, reducers, entity adapters, or any cached shape. Update selectors to read name instead of title.
  b) Invalidate or migrate caches that may store title. On deploy, clear persisted caches/localStorage keyed by entries to ensure stale title data is not used. Add a one-time cache-busting step if you persist normalized entities.

5) Tests
  a) Update unit, integration, and e2e tests that asserted presence of title in API responses or UI to instead assert using name only. Remove assertions for fallback-to-title behavior.
  b) Add tests that ensure forms and API client code do not send title. Specifically: simulate form submission and assert request body has no title field.
  c) Add a test that verifies the frontend handles a 422 validation error from the server gracefully when title is present in a request (this verifies the frontend surfaces server validation errors). Do not assume server error message format beyond status 422; assert only that a 422 results in expected error-handling code path.

6) Error handling and validation
  a) Add client-side validation preventing inclusion of title in outgoing payloads (strip any accidental title field if present in form/state before sending). This is defensive: do not rely solely on server-side validation.
  b) Ensure the UI surfaces 422 validation errors from the server when they occur (e.g., show message or form error). Keep error behavior generic — do not parse or transform title-specific server internals.

7) Documentation and API contract in frontend repo
  a) Update any frontend-side API documentation, example payloads, and README to reflect that responses do not include title and requests must not include title.
  b) Document the preserved facts in this change log: server 422 for title-including requests; database field name unchanged; description/id/owner_id/created_at unchanged.

8) Release checklist and verification (frontend-side)
  a) Confirm there are no remaining references to entry.title in production code or tests.
  b) Run unit/integration/e2e tests; all should pass after updates.
  c) Verify with a real API (staging) that responses for entries do NOT include title and include name and unchanged fields. In automated integration tests, assert response JSON does not have a title key when calling the public entries endpoint.
  d) Verify outgoing create/update requests do not include title by running a smoke test against the API and inspecting network traces (or using a mocked client test). If server returns 422 for an accidental title-bearing request, verify UI shows the 422 error path correctly.
  e) Clear/invalidate any client caches (localStorage, IndexedDB) on deploy to avoid showing stale title data.

Notes and constraints (explicit, do not change):
- Do NOT rename database fields or attempt to synchronize frontend names with DB internals; the DB field name remains unchanged and is a backend concern.
- Do NOT assume any other API changes beyond the stated facts. Specifically, do not add logic that expects title to ever appear in responses.
- Do not attempt to reintroduce title as a fallback anywhere in UI code.

Deliverables (frontend repo):
- Pull request with code changes: updated types, API client, components, state, tests, and documentation.
- Test results showing updated unit/integration/e2e tests passing.
- A short deployment note indicating caches were invalidated and tests performed against staging to confirm absence of title in responses.

Acceptance criteria for frontend portion (explicit):
- No production code references .title for entry objects.
- Outgoing create/update request payloads do not include a title key (verified by unit test and a smoke test).
- UI no longer uses title as fallback; components render only entry.name for names.
- Tests updated and passing. Integration test against API confirms responses do not contain title and contain unchanged fields: id, description, owner_id, created_at.
- Frontend surfaces 422 server errors when they occur; client-side validation prevents sending title.

Implement only these frontend changes; do not attempt backend or DB changes. Do not rely on or include any undocumented historical implementation details.

backend.prompt:
目标（仅后端实施指令）

实现要求（必须全部满足）：
- 在所有对外公开的“条目（entry）”响应中彻底移除字段 title，仅输出字段 name（即响应 JSON/对象中不得包含 title 键）。
- 对外请求中如果包含 title 字段，服务器应继续返回 422 Unprocessable Entity（即请求含 title 时仍被视为无效）；不得改为接受或忽略该字段而成功处理。
- 数据库层面的列名/字段名不得更改，数据库中仍保留列/属性名 title（不做任何迁移或重命名）。
- 其它字段保持不变：description、id、owner_id、created_at 等字段在请求与响应中的行为、名称和语义不得更改。
- 不要假设或更改前端逻辑；仅在后端实现并保持与上面约束一致（注意：即便前端会做调整，该约束仍须在后端显式满足）。

实施范围（后端必须覆盖的代码区域）
- 所有将 entry 对象序列化到对外响应的代码路径：包括但不限于 REST list endpoints（GET /entries）、detail endpoints（GET /entries/{id}）、搜索/过滤接口、批量接口、嵌套资源（例如 /owners/{id}/entries）、导出/feed 接口、任何 GraphQL resolver 或 RPC 返回 entry 的地方。
- 请求输入校验层：create/update/patch 的请求验证器、中间件或 schema 校验逻辑。
- API 文档/模式（OpenAPI/JSON Schema/GraphQL schema 等）：同步移除响应模型中的 title，并在请求模型中保留对 title 的禁止（或在文档中标注：请求含 title 将返回 422）。
- 单元/集成/端到端测试、契约测试、和自动化回归测试。
- 日志/缓存/序列化辅助函数：确保没有将 title 写回对外响应或缓存层被不经意公开。

具体实现步骤（按优先级与顺序）
1) 定位序列化层
   - 找出负责将 entry（条目）对象转换为 API 响应的 serializer/DTO/view-model/response-mapper。必须在该层显式排除 title 字段并包含 name 字段。
   - 如果当前使用自动映射（例如 ORM -> 自动 JSON），改为使用显式字段投影或明确的输出模型，确保 title 不被包含。
   - 确保所有返回 entry 集合或单个 entry 的端点都使用更新后的序列化逻辑。

2) 实施请求校验（对 title 返回 422）
   - 在请求 body 的校验阶段（schema 校验、中间件、控制器入口），添加检查：若请求体中存在顶层 key 'title'（任意值），立即返回 422。
   - 返回格式应遵循现有 API 的错误响应格式（保持 status code 422，与其他校验错误一致）。错误信息应明确："title 字段 不被接受/禁止"，并在 error details 中列出该字段名。
   - 该校验必须应用于所有允许发送 entry payload 的 endpoints（POST/PUT/PATCH/bulk endpoints）。

3) 保持数据库结构不变
   - 不要对数据库做任何迁移来删除或重命名 title 列。实现中应明确注释/文档指出：数据库仍含 title 列，但不会暴露给对外 API。
   - 若 ORM 模型有映射属性 title，可保持该属性用于内部逻辑/后台任务，但序列化器不得包含它。

4) 更新 API 模式与文档
   - 在 OpenAPI/JSON Schema/GraphQL schema 中移除响应模型里的 title 字段。
   - 在文档中标注：若请求包含 title，API 将响应 422（并示例 422 的错误体）；不描述后端如何在内部保留该列。
   - 保证 API 文档与实际行为一致（避免前后不一致导致契约测试失败）。

5) 测试覆盖（必须包含）
   - 单元测试：序列化器/mapper 的单元测试应断言输出 JSON 对象不包含 title 且包含 name，以及其他字段（description,id,owner_id,created_at）保持不变。
   - 集成测试/端到端测试：对所有对外 endpoints（list/detail/search/bulk）执行请求，验证响应中无 title 字段；验证 name/description/id/owner_id/created_at 正确且格式不变。
   - 校验测试：对 create/update/patch/bulk 请求包含 title 的情况，应得到 422；断言返回体遵循统一的错误格式并包含关于 title 的错误信息。
   - 回归测试：确认其它校验与 error-handling 未被破坏；确认数据库仍包含 title 列（例如直接查询信息模式/列存在断言）。

6) CI / 部署前检查
   - 在 CI 中加入自动化检查：对关键端点进行响应字段白名单校验（断言 response.keys ⊆ allowed_set，其中 allowed_set 明确不含 title）。
   - 确保没有数据库迁移脚本试图修改 title 列。

7) 运行时与运维注意点
   - 清点所有可能会以旧响应形式暴露 title 的辅助路径：缓存层、对外日志（如 structured logs 被以 API 响应直接返回时）、事件消息（邮件模板/通知 API），必要时在这些路径也要确保不对外公开 title。
   - 若系统有 API 网关/响应修改层，确保不会在网关上恢复或插入 title 字段。

验收标准（必须全部通过）
- 自动化/人工测试：GET /entries、GET /entries/{id}、相关嵌套与批量接口的响应 JSON 中没有 title 字段；name 字段存在并正确。
- 对 create/update/patch/bulk 等带有请求体的端点，若请求 body 包含 title，服务器返回 422 且返回体中包含关于 title 的错误信息（错误响应格式与系统其他 422 校验保持一致）。
- 数据库结构未变：确认 title 列仍存在且未被重命名或删除（通过 schema check 或不运行迁移来保证）。
- 其它字段（description、id、owner_id、created_at）在响应/请求中长度、格式与语义不变。
- OpenAPI/Schema 文档与运行时一致：响应模型不包含 title，文档说明请求含 title 得到 422。

附加实现细节与示例伪逻辑（用于指导实现者，不绑定具体语言）
- 序列化器示例（伪代码）：
  output = {
    "id": entry.id,
    "name": entry.name,
    "description": entry.description,
    "owner_id": entry.owner_id,
    "created_at": entry.created_at
  }
  // 不包含 entry.title

- 请求校验伪逻辑：
  if 'title' in request.json:
      return error_response(status=422, code='invalid_field', detail="'title' is not accepted")

- 如果存在自动映射配置（例如允许字段白名单），将白名单改为显式包含 name/description/id/owner_id/created_at，或使用黑名单排除 title（推荐显式白名单以避免意外暴露新字段）。

不得做的事（明确禁止）
- 不要重命名或删除数据库列 title。
- 不要在后端接受并保留 title 的同时对外返回 title（即内部保留与对外保留必须分离）。
- 不要仅依赖前端去不发送 title；后端必须显式校验并返回 422。

交付清单（部署前必须有）
- 代码变更：序列化器/请求校验/文档/测试。
- 自动化测试通过的 CI 报告（包括新加入的断言）。
- 更新后的 API 文档/模式文件（OpenAPI/GraphQL schema 等）。
- 部署说明：明确说明无数据库迁移。

备注
- 本指令集合只涉及后端实现细节；前端的移除回退逻辑属于前端工作，但后端仍须按上文约束提供一致行为以保证端到端契约。
